newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adelaide Bank cuts home loan rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adelaide Bank cuts home loan rates.

text.p: The Adelaide Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it had cut its variable home loan rate by 0.5 percentage points to 8.25 percent, effective for new and existing customers from January 31. The cut was in response to the monetary policy easing announced earlier.
Adelaide Bank said it has also cut the rate on its securitised First Home Loan by the same amount to 7.49 percent.
It said it has also cut its three-year fixed term rate to 7.9 percent from 8.4 percent and has moved its special home loan package with a fixed for one-year rate down to 6.4 percent.
